name: capstone
description: Shared Git collaboration tooling for the monorepo

scripts.backend:stop: docker compose -f infra/compose/compose.local.yml --profile backend stop backend
scripts.ai:stop: docker compose -f infra/compose/compose.local.yml --profile ai stop ai
scripts.local:up: docker compose -f infra/compose/compose.local.yml --profile backend --profile ai up -d --build
scripts.local:down: docker compose -f infra/compose/compose.local.yml --profile backend --profile ai down
